story.headline: NIFTY 25,607 is in an uptrend (+8.2% vs its 50-day average, +6.7% vs its 200-day), trending (ADX 49), momentum nearing overbought (RSI 66), India VIX 16.6 (higher than on 73% of the past year's sessions).

bottom: Direction: no active state has a reliable direction record. Over any 10 sessions NIFTY has risen 57% of the time; that is the base rate to beat.
